attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Pharmacy (SC LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited continuing pharmacy education or CME Category I, or both
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first renewal period after licensure by examination or license transfer.
rules.carryover: Excess hours may be carried forward to the next license year only (not more than one year).
rules.alternatives: The Board may grant an exemption for pharmacists enrolled in an approved pharmacy postgraduate degree program (application + official transcript).
rules.audit_note: Board audits CE of a random 10% of active pharmacists.

topics.who: Approved procedures for monitoring Schedule II, III and IV controlled substances

rules.notes: Licenses expire April 30 each year; mailed renewals are due before April 1 (late penalty $50). At least 50% of hours must be in drug therapy or patient management. Live-hour rules on the Board site could not be checked (site unreachable).
